title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up for chronic medical conditions.

History of Present Illness
The patient is a known patient with type 2 diabetes. He reports adhering to his current regimen. He has also been diagnosed with chronic kidney disease stage 4. I reviewed his labs today and confirmed that the current stage of CKD stage 4 is unrelated to diabetes. He continues to use long-term insulin for his management of type 2 diabetes mellitus and takes no oral diabetes medications.

Medication List
Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
Vitals are stable. Physical exam is unremarkable.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus: Stable. Managed with insulin.
2. Chronic kidney disease stage 4: Stable. The current stage of CKD stage 4 is considered unrelated to diabetes.

Plan
Continue current insulin regimen for type 2 diabetes mellitus. Follow up as scheduled. Patient education provided regarding monitoring for CKD stage 4 progression.
explanations: The provider states the CKD is not due to diabetes, so the presumed link does not apply: code diabetes without complications and CKD separately.
Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.
Long-term insulin use in type 2 diabetes: add Z79.4.

distractors.why: The 'with' presumption is overridden when the provider documents another cause or no link.
The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.
Z79.4 is required for routine insulin use in type 2 diabetes.
